# Why this run exists

The corrector arm (`accuracy-network-corrector.qmd`, DECISIONS D54, D55) measures
accuracy with the Study 3 corrector. This post hoc, exploratory run repeats it
with an off-the-shelf detector, ELECTRA (Yuan et al., 2021), whose flagged tokens
per token fill the same four nodes (D56). Flags are tokens and corrections are
edits, so the two arms compare in rank and not in level. Community numbering is
arbitrary, so compare membership with `network-analysis.qmd` rather than labels.

```{r}
#| label: drop-parameter
#| code-fold: false

# No predictability node is held out.
drop_var <- NULL

# The four flag rates (nodes.py), with their plot labels.
extra_nodes <- c(flag_mechanics = "Mech", flag_grammar = "Gram",
                 flag_det_prep = "DetPrep", flag_lexical = "LexPhr")
extra_nodes_file <- "data/study3/ellipse/accuracy_network/nodes_electra.csv"
run_dir <- "results/study3/ellipse/accuracy_network/electra"
```
